# Generated by "Claude files/tools/apply_school_reports_2026-11-13.py". Change the tables there and re-run on a backup.
# Country scope. The five-year school report (DA_Tech_Tree_event.40).

# Refresh the five experience multipliers (1 + the fake modifier), as DA_Tech_prov.<school> does.
DA_SR_refresh_multipliers = {
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Alchemy_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Mechanics_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Medicine_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Metallurgy_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
}

# do = grant: add the experience (call it inside hidden_effect). do = note: only the line of the report.
DA_SR_grant = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_$var$_exp_temp value = $amount$ }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_$var$_exp_temp which = DA_$var$_exp_modifier_var }
	change_variable = { which = DA_$var$_exp which = DA_$var$_exp_temp }
}

DA_SR_note = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_$school$.$amount$
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_$var$_exp_modifier_var value = 1.01 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_SR_$var$_multiplied_tt
	}
}

					limit = { DA_AM_school_due_Metallurgy = yes NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy } }
					custom_tooltip = DA_SR_Metallurgy_ready_1_tt
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { num_of_owned_provinces_with = { value = 10 OR = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_0 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_1 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_2 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_3 } } }
				DA_SR_$do$ = { school = Metallurgy var = Metallurgy amount = 400 }
				custom_tooltip = DA_SR_bonus_200_tt
				if = {
					limit = { DA_AM_school_due_Metallurgy = yes NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy } }
					custom_tooltip = DA_SR_Metallurgy_ready_1_tt
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { num_of_owned_provinces_with = { value = 5 OR = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_0 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_1 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_2 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_3 } } }
				DA_SR_$do$ = { school = Metallurgy var = Metallurgy amount = 300 }
				custom_tooltip = DA_SR_bonus_100_tt
				if = {
					limit = { DA_AM_school_due_Metallurgy = yes NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy } }
					custom_tooltip = DA_SR_Metallurgy_ready_1_tt
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { num_of_owned_provinces_with = { value = 1 OR = { has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_0 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_1 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_2 has_building = DA_Smelting_Furnace_3 } } }
				DA_SR_$do$ = { school = Metallurgy var = Metallurgy amount = 200 }
				custom_tooltip = DA_SR_bonus_0_tt
				if = {
					limit = { DA_AM_school_due_Metallurgy = yes NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy } }
					custom_tooltip = DA_SR_Metallurgy_ready_1_tt
				}
			}
			else = {
				custom_tooltip = DA_SR_Metallurgy_none_0_tt
			}
		}
	}
}
